logical_monotonicity_issue: The checker permits NOT B alone, but rejects the strictly stronger A AND NOT B using the same observations. Adding a true retained-context requirement narrows the accepted successor states; it cannot make this conjunction weaker than the already permitted rule.

recommendation.general_rule: After immutable-final conflict checks, reject a proposed stage when its entire check conjunction is already passed in the current readable observation. Allow retained expect_text if at least one currently unmet predicate requires an independently observed transition.
recommendation.equivalent_progress_condition: any required expected text absent now OR any forbidden text present now; keep current unreadable/error observations conservative.
reject_cases: Only the currently visible operation label is required.
Every expected term is already present and every forbidden term is already absent.
preserve: Caller final expect/forbid lists are unchanged.
Generated forbid_text conflicting with caller final-required text is refused under the existing conservative policy.
Completed instruction/check-signature no-replay gate remains independent and unchanged.
All schema/format/constraint repairs remain inside the same request and time budgets.
A child and overall success still require fresh observations and independent final checks.
recommendation.not_recommended: Do not accept a model claim of completion, infer that an input happened from a proposed check, change the final acceptance rules, add fixture-specific strings, or rewrite any prior failed run.

limits: A false initial conjunction and true later conjunction are evidence of a checked state transition, not proof of which physical input caused it.
OCR misses can imitate disappearance; real fixture events, stable-window checks and one-to-one input attribution remain necessary.
